:::{#def-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error

A [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn$ has as its [estimand](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/estimation.html#def-estimand)
the observed [outcome](#def-outcome) $\Outvar$ of a [new observation](#def-new-observation) with [input](#def-input) $\Predvar$,
not the [conditional mean](#def-cond-expectation-function) of that outcome.
The **prediction error** of $\predfn$ is the prediction minus that outcome:

$$\prederrf{\predfn} \eqdef \predfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar$$

:::
